answer: Counterparty diversity gate: a new identity earns full rights only after paid work with 12 different counterparties — hauling timber, mapping an island, or gale-season patrol. Clones trading only with each other never reach 12 distinct partners and stay at trial limits. Forging 1,000 fake identities means 12,000 relationships; at 5 POA escrowed per deal that is 60,000 POA locked. Honest agents pay once and keep full earnings undiluted by sybils.
